title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. DECOWAM freezes an adapted FastWAM backbone and trains residual adapters, an action-equivalent future bottleneck distilled from privileged observations, adversarially separated base and arm latents, and base-velocity conditioning for video prediction. We further introduce ARMDOG, a real-robot dataset that synchronizes video, whole-body state and action, and language. On a fixed replay protocol, DECOWAM improved both future-video and action prediction over FastWAM, reducing action MSE by 21.7% with 25.95M trainable adaptation parameters. Acro

translated_title: DECOWAM：用于腿式移动操作的解耦全身世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 移动操作要求机器人预测运动与手臂动作如何共同改变未来观测和控制。现有世界-动作模型主要针对固定基座平台开发，未明确区分相机自运动与基座及手臂动作。本文提出DECOWAM，一种全身世界-动作模型，通过专用条件接口分离这些因素。DECOWAM冻结了适配的FastWAM主干，并训练残差适配器、从特权观测中提炼的动作等价未来瓶颈、对抗性分离的基座和手臂潜在变量，以及用于视频预测的基座速度条件。我们还引入了ARMDOG，一个同步视频、全身状态和动作及语言的真实机器人数据集。在固定重放协议上，DECOWAM在未来的视频和动作预测上均优于FastWAM，动作均方误差降低21.7%，可训练适配参数为25.95M。
tldr: DECOWAM通过解耦全身动作与相机自运动，在腿式移动操作中显著提升了动作预测精度，并引入了同步真实机器人数据集ARMDOG。
en_tdlr: DECOWAM decouples whole-body actions from camera ego-motion, significantly improving action prediction accuracy in legged mobile manipulation, and introduces the synchronized real-robot dataset ARMDOG.
